macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. stocks plunge as AI trade selloff intensifies
items.summary: The Nasdaq Composite fell 5.13% to 22,654.15, while the S&P 500 dropped 3.59% to 6,918.45 and the Dow lost 1.85% to 48,188.18. The declines confirmed corrections in the S&P 500 and Dow and erased the Nasdaq’s 2026 gains.[1]

items.title: Anthropic debut fails to reassure investors
items.summary: A weak market reaction to Anthropic’s debut deepened concerns about elevated AI valuations and the sustainability of the technology-led rally, contributing to broad declines in U.S. equities.[1]

items.title: Fed officials signal support for further rate hikes
items.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook argued that the current policy rate is not high enough to address inflation, while other officials cited resilient growth and labor-market conditions as reasons to maintain a hawkish stance ahead of the December meeting.[1][4]

items.title: Dollar rally loses momentum amid risk-off trading
items.summary: The U.S. dollar eased broadly as its recent rally, driven by expectations for a hawkish Federal Reserve, weakened; however, demand for safer assets limited the currency’s losses.[1]

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin falls below $60,000 as crypto sell-off deepens
items.summary: Bitcoin dropped below $60,000 for the first time in four months, reaching roughly $58,678 before recovering near $59,467, down about 4.7% in 24 hours. Ethereum fell about 6.5% to approximately $1,644, while spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $582 million in net outflows, including $541.1 million from BlackRock’s IBIT.[1]

items.title: Major altcoins plunge as $63 billion leaves crypto market
items.summary: Ethereum fell below $1,657, XRP dropped under $0.90, and Solana declined below $67 as a sharp sell-off erased about $63.09 billion from the overall cryptocurrency market.[5]

items.title: Crypto liquidations exceed $1.4 billion
items.summary: Leveraged cryptocurrency positions worth approximately $1.405 billion were liquidated over 24 hours, with long positions accounting for 92.07% of the total.[6]

items.title: Wrapped Monero token crashes after suspected exploit
items.summary: A Monero-backed token on Hyperliquid reportedly plunged about 99% after 5.2 million XMR1 tokens were transferred from a wallet controlled by its deployer, in an incident estimated at roughly $13.5 million.[2][4]

items.title: Hong Kong advances licensing requirements for virtual-asset firms
items.summary: Hong Kong gazetted legislation requiring virtual-asset dealing, advisory, management, and custody providers to obtain a license from or register with the Securities and Futures Commission.[7]

items.title: EU considers expanding MiCA oversight of non-EU stablecoin issuers
items.summary: The European Union is preparing a 2027 review of its Markets in Crypto-Assets framework that could bring stablecoin issuers based outside the bloc under more direct regulatory oversight.[9]

items.title: Swift prepares blockchain ledger pilots with 17 banks
items.summary: Swift says its blockchain-based ledger is ready for pilot programs involving 17 banks, focused on tokenized deposits and continuous cross-border payments.[9]

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI reportedly sets entertainment-launch record
items.summary: Rockstar Games and Take-Two Interactive reported $3.79 billion in worldwide retail sales during Grand Theft Auto VI’s first 24 hours, including 32.5 million preorders. The launch follows the series’ first new release in 13 years.

items.title: Ubisoft cuts 166 jobs in Canada
items.summary: Ubisoft reduced its Canadian workforce by 166 positions, part of broader staffing reductions totaling roughly 1,100 employees over six months. The cuts come as the company reported quarterly bookings of €389 million.

items.title: League of Legends patch 26.23 released
items.summary: Riot Games’ latest patch buffs Annie, Ezreal and K’Sante while nerfing LeBlanc and Master Yi. It also updates ARAM: Mayhem, Arena, several champion features and DJ Sona’s interactive music.

items.title: The Finals Grand Major 2026 announced for Stockholm
items.summary: The Finals’ Grand Major 2026 is scheduled to begin November 27 in Stockholm. Organizers are offering Twitch-drop cosmetics and prediction contests for viewers.

items.title: Dead by Daylight previews The Terrifier balance changes
items.summary: Behaviour Interactive detailed adjustments arriving with Dead by Daylight update 10.3.0, including a larger detection radius for the Bike Horn and nerfs to the Duct Tape and Explosive Gift add-ons.

items.title: Baldur’s Gate 3 prequel novel featuring Shadowheart announced
items.summary: A new prequel novel by Tasha Suri will follow Shadowheart in an underground murder investigation involving a secretive religious order beneath Baldur’s Gate.
